title: Sync from live: a copy-only row (in neither base nor live) that clashes on a unique key with a row the live site added, and equals it on every column but the number and the placing/stamp columns, is one record under two numbers: the copy takes the live number with its references and no conflict is reported; a copy row Tracy changed, or a different record, is still a unique-key conflict
expect: S1: the copy's administrator menu items 101/102 (copy-only since a sync before #1699 kept them) and the live site's re-inserted 2400/2401 merge with no kept and no conflict: the copy ends with 2400/2401 (2401 under 2400), no 101/102, modules_menu (90, 2400), Tracy's edit of item 3 kept, and the next sync merges nothing
S1: when Tracy changed 101's title, 2400 stays a unique-key conflict and the copy keeps 101
S1: a different copy-only record (50 news, category 8) against a live one (60 news, category 9) stays a unique-key conflict beside the resolved menu items
S1: every other test of the file passes, the three #1699 tests among them

selectors.host: live_sync.py DbMerge.join_same_records (before read_schemas), IdMap.renumber on the copy's schema

fence: A sync never keeps reporting a conflict for a record both sides hold, identical, under two numbers

tests: a copy-only row that is the same record as a row the live site added under another number
a copy-only row Tracy changed is not the live row under another number
a different copy-only record clashing on the unique key with a live one is still a conflict
a row the live site deleted and inserted again under a new number
